brief: CRITIC round 3 on W1-09 combat core
findings: NODE ARENA VERIFIED: tools/lib/combat-node.mjs reproduces the browser exactly. My own browser probe (critic-w1-09-r3.mjs --probe reach, headless Chromium, arena_champion, E1 respawned with explicit yaw) gives min/max/interior-gaps identical to the node arena for 4 enemy attacks and 4 player weapons. Safe to use node for volume, browser for headline.

THE ROUND-2 CRITIC PROBE IS NOW STALE, NOT A FINDING: critic-w1-09-r2.mjs --probe reach reports chop/thrust/combo_a hit at NO distance 0-4 m on this build, because Engine.setEntityPos() ignores opts.yaw and round 3 removed the enemy yaw snap. Re-spawn with spawn(...,{yaw}) instead.
S26 ZERO-ROOT GUARD HOLDS: with root_dz_m overridden to 0 on every enemy attack, body hits = 0 at every distance and no hit at 0 m. The body hazard is NOT a proximity check.

BUT THE WEAPON HOLE IS UNTOUCHED. Ablation with body_hazard deleted from hitgeometry.json: chop min 1.2, thrust 1.6, combo_a 1.1, combo_b 1.2 — round 2 numbers exactly. Every hit inside those radii is via:body, and a body hit deals the WEAPON DAMAGE (chop 96 at 0.05 m via body == 96 at 3.65 m via weapon).
BODY SEPARATION IS INERT FOR REACH: with radii zeroed, every hit set is identical. It removes no hit and adds none.

MEASURED CONTACT DISTANCE AT MIN PLACEMENT = 0.5987 m in BOTH node and browser for all 4 attacks. The advertised 0.05 m is a PLACEMENT distance; separation shoves the target to the 0.6 m boundary before the blow lands. Max target push during one chop = 1.625 m.

TURTLE STILL WINS. My own cadence (attacks back-to-back at each move total): the mashing turtle kills the 2876-HP champion at every stand distance 0.0-2.6 m. At 0.0 m it takes 12.1% damage in 40.3 s. cmb-reach never tests 0.0 or 0.2 m.

INTERIOR GAPS: spear 1.20-1.25, halberd 1.15-1.30 sit exactly at the seam between the body corridor outer edge (1.15/1.10) and the weapon band inner edge (1.30/1.35). Builder attribution to W1-10 is half right: with body_hazard deleted the spear/halberd weapon-only min is 1.30/1.35, so the roster does have an inner hole — but the GAP is produced by the two-band architecture.
cmb-reach.mjs --verify DOES NOT EXIST. Both cmb-reach.mjs:37 and combat-node.mjs:12 assert it checks node-vs-browser; the flag is silently ignored (exit 0).
A2 dice: 60 identical scripted hits, one damage value (63), stdev 0.
next_step: browser turtle + yaw; then exemplar recompute, greed-scale 0, transition snaps, parry, poise probes, trace-stats, AR checks
